mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment exceeds 8.0%, it signals a weakening labor market and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales above their 12-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production growth (YoY > 3%), the economy expands, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO YoY growth exceeds 3%.

mechanism_narrative: Positive month-over-month growth in non-farm payrolls indicates a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate hiring, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS MoM growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in unemployment and decline in non-farm payrolls indicates a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%), the Federal Reserve typically tightens monetary policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3%.
